About Us

Born in Kuppam.
Built for Dravida.

Digital Dravida is a hyperlocal media and marketing hub headquartered in Kuppam — a unique tri-state border town at the meeting point of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu. We tell real stories, build real brands, and create real impact for our community.

What We Do

Services that Move Businesses

From a local clinic's first Instagram reel to a politician's full campaign — Digital Dravida delivers content, reach, and results for Kuppam's growing economy.

01 📱
Social Media Management
Full management of Instagram, Facebook & WhatsApp for local businesses, clinics, tuition centers, and brands. Posts, reels, stories — all handled.
₹3,000 – ₹8,000 / mo
02 ✨
AI-Powered Creatives
Festival posters, product launch flyers, event creatives — designed with AI + Canva for quality that rivals big-city agencies, at local prices.
₹500 – ₹5,000 / project
03 🎬
Reels & Short Video
High-reach reels and YouTube Shorts for businesses and creators. From scripting to editing — professional output with local authenticity.
₹2,000 – ₹8,000 / reel
04 🏛️
Political Branding
Personal branding packages for ward members, aspiring leaders & political figures. Campaign content, event coverage, WhatsApp packs, and visibility strategy.
₹5,000 – ₹1.5L / campaign
05 📣
Advertising Agency
Full-service local advertising — digital campaigns, WhatsApp marketing, sponsored content on our high-reach platforms, and hyperlocal ad targeting.
Custom Packages
06 💼
Job Consultancy
Connecting Kuppam's talent with opportunities across AP, Karnataka & Tamil Nadu. Placement support for freshers, skilled workers, and BPO roles.
